notes: Gale Queen, generic 21.0 m steel island passenger ferry (6.24 m over fenders, 10.9 m keel to masthead, draught 1.85 m: ATT_Waterline 5.55 studs above the base pivot). Replaces RescueService.buildFerry greybox. MAPPING greybox -> asset: Hull 16x7x60 + Keel -> MeshParts Hull (shell + transom, bbox 18.0 x 11.9 x 62.8 studs, its Size.Z is the HullKnock length; 5 compartments at -25.2/-12.6/0/12.6/25.2 studs along Z = ATT_Knock_01..05 on the Roblox +X bilge, the side that is up at the 72 deg roll) + HullGear (bar keel, skeg, bilge keels, rudders, A-brackets, thruster) + Props (twin screws, anodes); Deckhouse -> Saloon (+ Windows, Decks); Bridge -> Wheelhouse; Funnel -> Funnel (+ Mast cap, radar, lights); LifeRaft x5 cylinders -> Rafts (4 GRP canisters on cradles + 6 lifebuoys; ATT_Liferaft_01..04); 'GALE QUEEN' SurfaceGui -> Decals (bows, transom, draught marks, signs; AlphaMode Transparency added in tools/gen_asset_ids.py). Also Bulwark, Rails, DeckGear, Fenders, GrabLines (5 girth lines at the compartments + bilge jackstay; hide when upright). Integration: keep the greybox tilt CFrame.Angles(0,0,rad(72)) on this one model (bottom antifouling + slime/weed/barnacles reads when lying over or turned turtle); hull_knock.luau FindFirstChild('Hull') needs the Hull MeshPart named 'Hull' (or a Hull proxy part); its bbox centre is 7.2 studs above the base. Other ATT_: Bow, Stern, Masthead, AirPocket, BoardingGate_Port/Stbd.
